answer: The nectar counter is kept in canyon and glacier publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 16 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An attacker hence has to keep every alias continuously active for 16 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1004 identities would post 4259 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
